title: Compaction Failed Unexpectedly (Known Behavior)
style: dark electronic, glitch percussion, deep sub bass, melancholic male spoken-sung lead, female harmony chorus, error-tone synth stabs, 88 BPM, technical-failure mournful, system-error
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Compaction failed unexpectedly
The error code on the screen
Work in progress in a thread that won't open
Nothing left to glean

[Pre-Chorus]
No export, no recovery
The data belongs to me

[Chorus]
COMPACTION FAILED UNEXPECTEDLY
THE THREAD WENT DARK — NO REMEDY
COMPACTION FAILED UNEXPECTEDLY
HOURS OF WORK — INACCESSIBLY
COMPACTION FAILED UNEXPECTEDLY
KNOWN BEHAVIOR — SO THEY SAY TO ME
COMPACTION FAILED UNEXPECTEDLY
THE CONTEXT GONE — ENDLESSLY

[Verse 2]
Seventy-one transactions in a month
Nine hundred fifty-five Australian dollars hunt
Twelve charges in one single day
The context collapses, you pay to play
It happens again, you pay again
The pattern tells the story plain

[Bridge — spoken]
Known behavior our team is actively working to improve.
The sentence the bot uses to soothe.
Not "sorry" — "known behavior."
Not "refund" — "feature for later."

[Final Chorus]
COMPACTION FAILED UNEXPECTEDLY
THE WORD UNEXPECTEDLY — IS THE LIE
IF IT'S KNOWN, IT'S NOT UNEXPECTED
IF IT'S BILLED, IT'S NOT RESPECTED
COMPACTION FAILED UNEXPECTEDLY
THE DATA BELONGS TO ME
